questions.question:
After interchanging which two signs, the value of the given equation will be '11'?

32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : + and -

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 - 3 + 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 - 3 + __**12 ÷ 18**__ × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 - 3 + __**0.66 × 9**__ = 11

⇒ __**32**__ - 3 __**+ 6**__ = 11

⇒ __**38 - 3**__ = 11

⇒ 35 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : × and -

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 + 3 × 12 ÷ 18 - 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + 3 × __**12 ÷ 18**__ - 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + __**3 × 0.66**__ - 9 = 11

⇒ __**32 + 2**__ - 9 = 11

⇒ __**34 - 9**__ = 11

⇒ 25 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷ and -

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 + 3 ÷ 12 - 18 × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + __**3 ÷ 12**__ - 18 × 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + 0.25 - __**18 × 9**__ = 11

⇒ __**32 + 0.25**__ - 162 = 11

⇒ 32.25 - 162 = 11

⇒ -129.75 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : ÷ and × 

Given equation is : 32 + 3 - 12 ÷ 18 × 9 = 11

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 32 + 3 - 12 × 18 ÷ 9 = 11

⇒ 32 + 3 - 12 × __**18 ÷ 9**__ = 11

⇒ 32 + 3 - __**12 × 2**__ = 11

⇒ __**32 + 3**__ - 24 = 11

⇒ __**35 - 24**__ = 11

⇒ **11 = 11**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and ×".**

questions.solution:

**Logic: **(First Number)³ + First Number = Second Number

11 : 1342 → 11³ + 11 = 1331 + 11 = 1342

Similarly,

7 : ? → 73 + 7 = 343 + 7 = 350

Hence, '**350**' is the correct answer.

In the following question, select the missing number of the given series.

4, 6, 8, 10, ?, 14
questions.solution:
**Logic :** (2) is added to each number subsequently

So, the series here is :

4 + 2 = 6

6 + 2 = 8

8 + 2 = 10

10 + 2 = **12**

**12** + 2 = 14

Hence, **"12"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements : **

Some houses are flats.

Some flats are spacious.

All spacious are expensive.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some flats are expensive.

II. Some houses are spacious.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f6f90517a463134fbb7bac942002e8299ae2aa78c491fbb2aaa5dd474d1dffc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flats are expensive → Follow (As some flats are spacious and all spacious are expensive. So, as whole spacious comes in expensive and has also some part common with flats therefore, it is definitely true)

II. Some houses are spacious → Does not follow (As some houses are flats and some flats are spacious. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion I follows".
